data.name: Farran
data.gender_notes: Farran is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'farara', meaning 'to be fragrant or to please'. In Islamic tradition, the name Farran is often given to boys as a symbol of spiritual delight and fragrance. The name Farran carries the meaning “Fragrant, Delightful” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Farran usually hope their child will grow to embody fragrant, delightful and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Farran total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
